title: Site works forward of the street setback line
text: Retaining walls, fill and excavation forward of the street setback line, not more than 0.5m above or below the natural ground level, except where necessary to provide for pedestrian universal access and/or vehicle access, drainage works, or natural light to a dwelling.

exceptions.label: necessary for universal or vehicle access, drainage or natural light

source.file: Residential Design Codes Chapter 3 - Grouped Dwellings.pdf

notes: Same as Chapter 2 C3.5.1. The fact is the greater of fill above and excavation below NGL forward of the line. Draft adds 'pedestrian universal access' to the exception list; otherwise as Part B C7.1 / Part C C3.5.1.
